newsitem.title: USA: IMM CURRENCIES REMAIN MIXED, MARKS FALTER, YEN UP.
newsitem.headline: IMM CURRENCIES REMAIN MIXED, MARKS FALTER, YEN UP.

text.p: Aug 6 - IMM currency futures remained mixed, with marks faltering and yen continuing to edge higher. Sept marks are expected to break below the contract low of $0.5303 in the near term. Sterling held sharp losses, while yen rose on USTR Barshefsky's comments that U.S. was concerned with the sharp drop in auto sales to Japan, traders said. ((Chicago Derivatives Desk (312)408-8750))
